data.name: Onaysa
data.gender_notes: Onaysa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Onaysa is derived from the word 'ona' which means 'nurse' or 'caregiver'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes the care and love of a mother towards her child. The name Onaysa carries the meaning “Nurse, caregiver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Onaysa usually hope their child will grow to embody nurse, caregiver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with love and compassion, symbolizing the nurturing and caregiving nature of mothers in Islam.
data.etymology: Onaysa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nurse, caregiver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Onaysa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
